label: sim-gate.test.mjs
why: Its assertions include a meeting-matrix wall-clock budget (14000 ms), which measures the speed of the machine and its load, not whether the engine is correct.
localGuard: node tests/sim-gate.test.mjs locally, and scripts/sim/audit/release-ready.mjs runs the sim lane on the release machine where the timing budget is meaningful.

label: audit-math-computation-sensitivity.mjs
why: The audit derives its thresholds from measured floating-point sensitivity on the CPU it runs on, so the numbers differ per machine without any code being wrong.
localGuard: node tests/audit-math-computation-sensitivity.mjs locally, where the thresholds were measured; scripts/sim/audit/release-ready.mjs refuses a release when the audit itself reports a regression on the release machine.

label: mutation-evidence.test.mjs
why: It copies the whole tree and runs real mutations for a couple of minutes, so its cost and its tmpdir layout are properties of the machine, not of the product.
localGuard: GATE_RELEASE=1 node tests/run-tests.mjs (the release sweep bypasses the mutation cache) and scripts/sim/audit/release-ready.mjs on the release machine.
